messages:
Alex Kim: hey @people-ops — quick question about my first paycheck and benefits kickoff. I updated my name in the People Ops portal yesterday (was listed as Alex K.). payroll still shows the old name. Will that block benefits enrollment or direct deposit? start date was 2026-03-01. also did my W-4 go through?
Priya Shah: hey Alex — thanks for flagging. we updated the HR profile but payroll sync runs overnight. that alone shouldn't block benefits enrollment. W-4 e-sign landed on 2026-03-02T14:12Z from your email so you're set there.
Alex Kim: awesome. curious if beneficiary forms for 401k / retirement need the exact legal name match? i have a signed pdf but the name differs by one character (middle initial).
Priya Shah: good Q — beneficiary forms should ideally match the legal name on payroll to avoid processing delays. if it's just a middle initial we can accept the form, but payroll and benefits like Fidelity/Health insurer will want the corrected name on file. easiest path: 1) confirm last 4 of SSN + bank last 4 via DM, 2) we trigger the name sync to payroll, 3) you re-upload beneficiary PDF if needed.
Alex Kim: how should i send SSN/bank last4? DM here or email hr@redwood.com?
Priya Shah: please DM me the details or use the secure upload link — do NOT post them in the channel. i'll DM you in a sec.
Onboarding Bot: :reminder: Benefits enrollment window for new hires ends in 27 days. Complete elections at https://redwood.example/benefits/enroll
Jordan (Payroll): FYI payroll can run an off-cycle correction if anything slips through, but for new hires with profile mismatches we waive the correction fee. :thumbsup:
Alex Kim: great, thanks all. i'll DM Priya now and re-upload beneficiary if you want the signed copy.
Priya Shah: received your DM, noted. i've submitted a ticket to payroll (TICKET-2026-4458) to sync the updated name; they'll confirm once the payroll file regenerates. i'll follow up in this thread when it's done.
Alex Kim: confirmed i sent the DM with last4s and the signed beneficiary pdf. thanks again!
Priya Shah: confirmed — payroll acknowledged the ticket and will pick it up with the overnight sync. expectation: change reflected in next payroll run. closing the loop here but ping if you don't see it in 2 pay cycles. :white_check_mark:
